resources.string: Checks every app and installs what is set to update by itself, as the background check does.
Check an app when its page opens
Not again within five minutes of the last check.
Apps that are only tracked are checked too. An app you open is always checked.
An app you uninstall outside Tern leaves the list as well.
A pattern every app without a filter of its own picks its file by.
Let Me Downgrade is installed, so Android may put an older version over a newer one.
A light tap when a swipe or a long press does something.
One pane and a bar at the bottom, however wide the screen.
Forges, repositories, stores and web pages, and which of them can be searched.
A web page with links to files
A direct link to a file
GitLab, Forgejo, Gitea and Jenkins on a server of their own are recognised by their address.
A site of ready-made settings for apps. Its links open in Tern when Open Obtainium links is on in Settings.
The filter for files inside archives matches none of the APKs in this one.
%1$s offers again what developers publish elsewhere. Its files are held to the developer\'s certificate once Tern knows it, so pin one or install from the developer first when you can.
%1$s offers apps changed by someone other than their developer. They are signed by whoever changed them, and Tern cannot tell what was changed.
Keep Tern itself up to date
Adds Tern\'s own releases to the list, checked and verified like any app.
